problem: The question opens with "A tank holds 100 L", which reads as tank capacity. On that reading an answer of 160 L in part (a) overflows the tank and 130 L is above capacity, so the problem looks physically impossible.
fix: "A tank contains 100 L at the start and fills at 5 L/min. (a) Open-loop: the pump runs 12 min. Final volume? (b) Closed-loop: target 130 L, ..." (or state a capacity larger than 160 L, e.g. "a 200 L tank").

problem: Fever is called "a disturbance", but the Exam traps say a disturbance enters at the plant while a shift of the target is a reference change. Fever resets the hypothalamic set point, so the two statements contradict each other and a student will not know how to classify it.
fix: "Fever resets the set point itself: the body then drives its temperature up to the new target, which is why chills and shivering appear." (Or say it is an internal disturbance that acts on the reference.)

problem: The controller is defined as deciding "from the reference and the error", but in Section 2 the open-loop controller has no error signal at all, so the definition does not fit half the chapter.
fix: "Controller — the device that decides what to do: in a closed loop from the reference and the error, in an open loop from the reference alone."
